dedupe_keys.name: crossroad camera dataset mobility aid users

description: Ludwig Mohr and colleagues at Graz University of Technology publish this pedestrian-crossing dataset to support detection of people using mobility aids in traffic monitoring, scheduling and planning. Images taken from an elevated monitoring viewpoint have ground-truth annotations in YOLO format. Classes distinguish pedestrians without mobility aids from users of wheelchairs, wheeled walkers, crutches and walking canes. Official training, validation and test splits are supplied. Coverage is one pedestrian crossing. The metadata dates image collection to October 2022 and publication to September 2023, but does not identify the crossing location or image sampling interval. Two public ZIP packages provide images, labels and metadata, including alternative labels for training with a class hierarchy. Access is free under CC BY-SA 4.0. The observations can inform traffic-monitoring inputs used in crossing-capacity planning; they do not provide a complete road-network simulation. The dataset accompanies a BMVC 2023 paper. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
